overview_description.description: Coder is an AI-native development platform that provides secure, self-hosted cloud development environments for developers and AI coding agents. It enables organizations to govern AI-assisted software development while maintaining control over infrastructure, security, and compliance. Coder helps enterprises accelerate developer onboarding, standardize workflows, and safely scale AI-powered development.

about_short_description.short_description: Coder provides open-source tools and an enterprise platform that makes it easier to configure, secure, and scale development environments.

product.name: Coder Workspaces
product.description: A self-hosted cloud development environment platform that provisions standardized workspaces for developers and AI agents across infrastructure such as Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.

product.name: Coder Agents
product.description: A native AI coding-agent platform for running software development workflows on self-hosted infrastructure with configurable model access, agent permissions, and execution controls.

product.name: Coder AI Governance
product.description: A centralized governance layer for controlling, observing, and auditing AI model and tool usage across Coder workspaces and agent environments.

product.name: Coder Agents
product.description: A self-hosted AI coding service that lets enterprises run coding agents and execution environments on infrastructure they control, including air-gapped environments.
